messages:
erin.docs: quick heads-up — i'm opening a tiny PR to add a 'Parse Cookbook' page under function-calling/structured-output. it's meant to be short, example-first, and focused on real edge cases we keep seeing (partial JSON, arrays of unions, unknown fields). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1278

matthew: awesome! can you add short JS + Python SDK snippets showing validation + fallback parsing? e.g.

`// js example (pseudo)`
`const res = await client.call(...);`
`try { const parsed = JSON.parse(res); validate(parsed, schema); } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }`

sara: i'll take a look in a bit. question: do we want the cookbook to recommend strict schema enforcement or permissive parsing by default? different teams expect different behavior.

erin.docs: good q — plan was to show both patterns with a note: strict for business-critical fields, permissive for UX fields (e.g., free-text). i'll add a short decision table.

ben: please include an explicit example for 'preserve unknown fields' — customers often want to roundtrip extras. also throw in a numeric coercion example (strings->ints) and a small note about locale.

matthew: adding a tiny Python snippet idea:
```
# python pseudocode
resp = client.generate(prompt)
try:
    body = json.loads(resp.text)
    schema.validate(body)
except JSONDecodeError:
    # attempt line-delimited parse or extract code block
    body = extract_json_block(resp.text)
```

sara: also flagging a couple links that need updating in the current function-calling guide: the schema examples link points to an old gist. i'll paste them in a follow-up comment on the PR.

docs-bot: PR opened by erin.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1278 :tada:

erin.docs: thanks! assigning @matthew for SDK snippets, @sara for link updates, @ben for edge-case examples. i'll push a first draft by EOD.

matthew: can we also add a tiny 'debugging' appendix — how to reproduce parse failures locally (prompt seeds, test harness)? i can stub that.

ben: +1 for debugging steps. also suggest a one-sentence "migration note" about older LLM outputs that may include trailing text after the JSON (mention extract_json_block helper).

sara: i'll review the PR tomorrow morning. if it looks good we can merge and route to the website build (docs-bot will pick it up). :thumbsup: 

erin.docs: perfect — thanks everyone. will ping again once draft is pushed.
